content.text:
All tests pass. 

The change extends the business-day rule to public holidays. I made it in the tiny `BusinessDays` class (which has near-zero surrounding complexity, so `WMC_other` is minimal), and I kept `roll` simple by extracting the day-check into a small cohesive `isBusinessDay` helper rather than growing `roll`'s condition:

- Added a fixed `HOLIDAYS` set (2026-01-01, 2026-01-26, 2026-04-25, 2026-12-25, 2026-12-28).
- `roll` now loops forward until it hits a non-weekend, non-holiday day.

Because `BusinessDays.roll` is the single shared entry point already used by `Owner.setRegistrationDate` (and elsewhere), no other files needed to change. `BUILD SUCCESS`, all tests green.
